decisions.reason: Given its core role in digital identity and only one year of launch, slack and strategic fit make a drop unlikely absent a clear shortfall.
The payment wallet aligns with the secure payment strategy, and early uncertainty is absorbed by organizational slack while results are compared with aspirations.
The NFC authenticator is a niche complement that may face adoption uncertainty, but no evident shortfall yet triggers problemistic search.
As a dedicated secure payment framework, it is central to the platform and likely meets strategic aspirations, so the firm keeps it.
The multi-service mobile app platform is the firm's strategic direction, and slack allows continued evaluation before comparing to aspirations.
The application shielding library supports the security portfolio, and its dedicated page signals commitment; no shortfall justifies dropping.
